exact_scope.time: No time evolution is proved here. The R-515 external stochastic Markov-time word simplex is used only for the conditional tail input.

conclusion.footprint: The OMC-004 degree and face-incidence bounds give at most 4 edge slots per base column, 16 PH/AP/LK roots per base column, and footprint radius at most 2 columns.
conclusion.overlap: The conservative proof-footprint branching bound is b=16*(4*2+1)=144. Exact enumeration gives maximum overlap degree including self 56 for n=2 and 70 for every tested n>=3, all below 144.
conclusion.first_roots: For a two-column local support the same source bound gives a=16*(2+2*2+1)=112 first roots. The non-importing independent lane uses a separate three-column fixture with first-root bound 128 and obtains the same b=144.
conclusion.conditional_tail: Substituting the source-derived a=112 and b=144 into the exact factorial connected-word envelope of R-515 gives a decreasing tail whenever b*T<d+1; the large-distance values are arithmetic diagnostics, not fitted PAH estimates.
conclusion.boundary: This closes only the combinatorial dependency-footprint input. It does not identify a connected word with A_n^(out,m)Q_n(s)g or any Duhamel/coupling term, so N2c/N4 remains open.
